_help.wrist_camera: Camera pose relative to the follower link `parent_link`. In gripper_link the gripper points along -Z. rpy_deg = mount rotation (roll, pitch, yaw about the link axes); the camera looks along its own +Z. roll_about_view_axis_deg rotates the camera (and image) around its viewing direction: use it to match the image's zero orientation to the wrist.
_help.joints: Mapping from the real arm to the URDF model, per joint: model = sign * real + offset, where sign = -1 when invert is true. Units: degrees, gripper in percent (0-100). Use offset to match the model's zero orientation (e.g. wrist_roll) to the real arm.
_help.leader_model_offset_m: Where the leader model is drawn relative to the follower model.
